authorization: None yet. This is a draft. It takes effect only if the owner adopts a research-reset amendment naming this campaign_id, adds it to config/research_reset.json registered_trials, sets status to registered and registers it with ai_trading.tools.experiment_ledger.register_campaign before any preflight. Proposal: docs/MULTI_DAY_STRATEGY_TRIAL_PROPOSAL_20261018.md.
hypothesis: The unmodified CrossSectionalMomentumStrategy (63-session lookback, top quantile 0.2, min_universe 6), scored on its buy signals only, earns positive net returns after a fixed 10 bps round-trip cost and beats an equal-weight always-long basket of the same universe on identical dates, when it rebalances every 5 sessions with non-overlapping holds.
economic_motivation: Medium-horizon relative strength across asset classes and sectors (Moskowitz and Grinblatt 1999; Asness, Moskowitz and Pedersen 2013) is a documented multi-week effect. A 5-session hold gives a gross move several times larger than a 10 bps cost, which the three failed intraday trials did not. The strategy class already exists in the runtime registry; this tests it as written, not a new model.
strategy_construction: REGISTRY[strategy]() with no arguments; the runner refuses to proceed unless the instance's lookback, top_quantile and min_universe equal strategy_parameters. No parameter search.
signal_policy: Only buy (top-bucket) signals are scored. sell_short signals are ignored: paper runs with TRADING__ALLOW_SHORTS=0 and the ETF precedent allowed no shorts.
universe_choice: Chosen by the timestamp-only daily support audit run against both verified development acquisitions on 2026-10-18 before any price was read. The stock set (AAPL, AMZN, MSFT) has 3 names, below min_universe 6, so the strategy can never emit a signal. The ETF set has exactly 6 names and meets every support threshold under the open_and_close_minutes rule; see the proposal for counts.

session_completeness.rationale: The rule needs only the session's first-minute open (entry and exit) and last-minute close (signal). A session counts if both minutes are present and every present minute has valid price geometry and positive volume; no minute-coverage floor is imposed. No interpolation or invented bars. This is the data contract docs/RESEARCH_RESET.md named on 2026-09-09 for a future campaign ('require only the completed closes and executable entry/exit observations used by the fixed rule'). DIA's 973 missing minutes in 243 sessions include no opening or closing minute; the largest gap in one session is 16 minutes. A 98 percent coverage floor was audited first, from timestamps only, and blocked (20 possible periods); it is disclosed in the proposal. This rule does not alter the consumed ETF trend campaign.

daily_bar: Regular-session OHLCV aggregated from verified one-minute bars: open = first regular minute open, high = max high, low = min low, close = last regular minute close, volume = sum; early closes use their own session end.
decision: After the close of development session t (index 63, then every 5 sessions), generate_signals receives each symbol's daily closes for sessions 0..t only.
exit: Regular-session open of session t+6 (t+1+hold); the next entry is the same open, so holds never overlap.
period_eligibility: A decision period counts only if every universe symbol has a complete session for every session from t-63 through t+6; incomplete sessions never shorten a lookback or move entry or exit dates.
allocation: Equal notional across the period's buy signals (one of six for a full universe); abstention holds cash at zero return; no leverage, shorts, compounding or volatility targeting.

cost_tiers.name: measured_paper_taker_median
cost_tiers.note: Median decision-time quoted spread (full-spread taker round trip) on AAPL, AMZN and MSFT paper fills; measured on stocks, not on this ETF universe. Declared before evaluation; it can never change the decision.

cost_accounting: Every period charges each selected slot one full round trip at the tier cost, even when the same symbol is selected again; the equal-weight always-long control is charged identically, so the paired comparison against always-long is cost-neutral.
support_rationale: 60 decision periods is the ETF trend precedent. With six names the strategy buys exactly one per period, so selections equal periods and the bootstrap unit is the period; the precedent's 100-selection count was for six independent per-symbol slots. Ten selections per quarter is 80 percent of the about 12.5 non-overlapping 5-session periods a quarter can hold.

acceptance.summary: All of: adequate support; positive 95 percent circular-block-bootstrap lower bound of net return per period versus cash at 10 bps; positive lower bound of the paired difference versus equal-weight always-long; positive aggregate net per period at 20 bps; at least 5 profitable quarters at 10 bps. The 6 bps and 2.8 bps tiers are reported only.

preconditions: research-reset amendment adopted and config/research_reset.json registered_trials cites this campaign_id
status set to registered and the contract registered under artifacts/cross_sectional_momentum_trial_20261018/campaign_state.json before any preflight
timestamp-only daily support audit passes for this contract
non-claiming preflight passes: source hashes, 2024-2025 date bounds, no 2026 timestamp, complete-session panel
stop_rule: Claim once immediately before signals are generated; no automatic retry after a claim, even after a crash. A failed preflight or support audit blocks without consuming the trial. A failed or inconclusive result retires this hypothesis and authorizes no lookback, quantile, hold, universe, cost or completeness tuning.
holdout_policy: Do not read or evaluate September 9 to December 8, 2026, or any 2026 data; no automatic future test or promotion. The ETF development data was used by the consumed September trend campaign and is not untouched.
execution_assumption: Historical regular-session open-to-open markouts on split-adjusted prices with fixed costs; executable fills and per-fill fees are not established.
limitations: Split-adjusted price markouts omit distributions and cash interest; they are not total returns.
Six ETFs give one selection per period; a passing result does not generalize to the stock paper universe without a separately registered evaluation.
The ETF development data was already used by the September trend study; the same 2024-2025 window is not untouched.
The measured paper cost tier comes from stock fills and is reported only.
